revision_plan.intent: Combined intent: Eliminate false-positive parallelism and missing activities caused by vague grouping and 'simultaneous behaviors' exceptions.; Enforce true parallelism mapping to prevent false-negative parallelism.
revision_plan.change_instruction: Combine these requested changes into one coherent section revision: Revise Step 1 to strictly prohibit decomposing lists of attributes, parameters, or properties into parallel branches; remove the 'simultaneous system behaviors' exception entirely. Instead, instruct the model to extract each explicitly stated action as its own distinct activity node, keeping enumerated attributes/parameters grouped within a single node. Add a condition that fork/join blocks are only permitted if an explicit concurrency cue (e.g., 'concurrently', 'in parallel', 'simultaneously') is present in the text.; Revise Step 3 to mandate that whenever an explicit concurrency cue (e.g., 'concurrently', 'simultaneously', 'in parallel') is present, the connected actions must be decomposed into separate activities and mapped to a fork/join block. Remove any language that merely 'suggests' or broadly mentions this mapping; make it a strict requirement triggered only by these specific textual cues.

revision_plan.intent: Combined intent: Remove the vague 'simultaneous system behaviors' exception that overrides sequential exclusions.; Provide specific guidance on loop scope and exit conditions to fix wrong_loop errors.
revision_plan.change_instruction: Combine these requested changes into one coherent section revision: Remove the clause '(e.g., 'Close window and display statistics')' and the concept of 'simultaneous system behaviors' from the concurrency modeling rule. Replace it with a strict rule: fork/join blocks must be used if and only if the text contains explicit concurrency keywords (e.g., 'concurrently', 'in parallel', 'simultaneously'). Reiterate that 'and'-joined clauses or comma-separated lists without these exact keywords must not be modeled as parallel.; Expand the loop modeling rule to specify how to determine loop scope and exit conditions: the loop boundary must strictly wrap only the activities explicitly modified by iterative cues (e.g., 'repeat', 'retry', 'periodically'). Add an instruction to identify the exit condition (e.g., text following 'until' or 'if successful') and map it to the 'while' or 'repeat until' construct, ensuring activities not explicitly part of the iteration remain outside the loop.

revision_plan.intent: Combined intent: Resolve the contradiction regarding collapsing actions and prevent hallucinated extra activities.; Provide explicit guidance for nested conditional logic to prevent flattened or missing relations.
revision_plan.change_instruction: Combine these requested changes into one coherent section revision: Revise the granularity rule to explicitly state that it overrides grouping heuristics: distinct specified actions must never be collapsed into a single node unless they are merely attributes/parameters describing a single action. Add a strict boundary condition: do not invent control-flow logic (e.g., 'Reject command', 'Allow command', or if-else branches) to enforce constraints unless the requirement text explicitly states alternative outcomes or conditional branching.; Expand the convergence rule to address nested conditional logic: when a requirement contains multi-branch decision logic (e.g., a switch/case inside an if/else), map the outer condition to an if/elseif/else structure and the inner condition to a nested switch/case or if structure. Specify that inner conditional paths must merge at their local join point before the outer conditional paths merge at the outer join point, preventing the flattening of nested control-flow.
